_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 95% of 12h windows flat and liquidity drivers collapsed while momentum holds, the coil has no breaker visible — Denial holds as conflicting forces cancel out.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Narrative leans bullish on the August bottom analog; Analyst rejects the analog as structurally broken and calls HOLD with medium conviction; consensus sides with the Analyst's higher-trust structural read.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain >40 for 3+ days with stablecoin growth turning positive and funding cooling below 40 — genuine capital rotation validating Denial→Hope leg up
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks $60K with funding spiking >70 and VIX >75 — forced long liquidation drops phase to Anxiety/Complacency, or ETF outflows accelerate confirming distribution not accumulation
